% 18.10.2023  [Through Hybrid Mode]
1.

The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of proceedings arising out of FIR bearing no.0229/2017 dated 19.05.2017 registered under sections 420/498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Khajuri Khas along with consequential proceedings.
2. The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 got married on 12.02.2016 according to Hindu rites and ceremonies and no child was born out of their marriage.
The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no.2 due to matrimonial differences, started to live separately since June 2016 without any cohabitation.
3. The respondent no.2 got registered present FIR bearing no. 0229/2017 dated 19.05.2017 under sections 420/498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Khajuri Khas wherein the petitioners were implicated.

The petitioner no.1 has already paid the entire settled amount as per the schedule as mentioned in the Settlement Agreement, which is acknowledged by the respondent no.2.
